_comment: Per-hardware metadata the portal Firmware UI surfaces. Keys are hardware_ids the bridge.info.published event resolves to via a small board-name → hardware-id map in main.py. NOTE on `instructions`: the portal triggers flash/DFU mode itself on Flash (esptool DTR/RTS reset for ESP32; 1200-baud USB touch for nRF52), so the manual button steps are written as a FALLBACK for when the automatic trigger can't reach the chip — they are not the normal path.

heltec_v4.label: Heltec V4 (LoRa32 v4) — ESP32-S3 + SX1262
heltec_v4.instructions: Just click Flash — the portal tries to reset the board into ESP32 download mode for you (esptool DTR/RTS). On this S3-native-USB board the auto-reset isn't always reliable, so the FALLBACK is more common here: if flashing can't connect to the chip, hold the BOOT button (next to USB-C) while plugging in USB, release BOOT after it's plugged in, then click Flash again. If it sticks, power-cycle the board and retry.

lilygo_techo.label: LilyGo T-Echo — nRF52840 + SX1262 + integrated L76K
lilygo_techo.instructions: Just click Flash — the portal drops the board into its bootloader for you (1200-baud USB touch) and copies the .uf2; the T-Echo reboots into the new firmware automatically. No need to touch the hardware. FALLBACK, only if the auto-touch fails: double-tap the small RESET button (pinhole near USB-C) so the TECHOBOOT drive mounts, then click Flash again.

rak4631.label: RAK4631 (WisCore) — nRF52840 + SX1262
rak4631.instructions: Just click Flash — the portal drops the board into its bootloader for you (1200-baud USB touch) and copies the .uf2; the board reboots into the new firmware automatically. No need to touch the hardware. FALLBACK, only if the auto-touch fails: double-tap the RESET button on the WisBlock carrier so the RAK4631 drive mounts, then click Flash again.

xiao_nrf52.label: Seeed XIAO nRF52840 — nRF52840 + Wio-SX1262
xiao_nrf52.instructions: Just click Flash — the portal drops the board into its bootloader for you (1200-baud USB touch) and copies the .uf2; the XIAO reboots into the new firmware automatically. No need to touch the hardware. FALLBACK, only if the auto-touch fails: double-tap the tiny RESET button (left of the USB-C port) so the XIAO-SENSE drive mounts, then click Flash again.

xiao_nrf52_lr2021.label: Seeed XIAO nRF52840 — nRF52840 + LR2021 (Waveshare Core2021)
xiao_nrf52_lr2021.instructions: Just click Flash — the portal drops the board into its bootloader for you (1200-baud USB touch) and copies the .uf2; the XIAO reboots into the new firmware automatically. No need to touch the hardware. FALLBACK, only if the auto-touch fails: double-tap the tiny RESET button (left of the USB-C port) so the XIAO-SENSE drive mounts, then click Flash again. Same nRF52840 MCU and bootloader as the plain xiao_nrf52 entry above — only the radio chip differs, hence the distinct label and hardware_id (see firmware/variants/xiao_lr2021/README_TDOA.md).

xiao_s3_wio.label: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 — ESP32-S3 + Wio-SX1262
xiao_s3_wio.instructions: Just click Flash — the portal resets the XIAO into the ESP32-S3 USB-JTAG ROM bootloader for you (esptool usb_reset → default_reset). On this S3-native-USB board the auto-reset isn't always reliable, so the FALLBACK: hold the BOOT button on the XIAO while plugging in USB-C, release after it's plugged in, then click Flash again. If it sticks, power-cycle (>15s unplugged) and retry.

wio_e5_mini.label: Wio-E5 mini — STM32WLE5JC (integrated SX126x)
wio_e5_mini.instructions: Just click Flash — the portal asks the running firmware to jump into its resident OpenBootloader (companion CMD_ENTER_USB_DFU → the firmware sets a TAMP flag and resets), then writes the app over the CP2102 with stm32flash. No need to touch the hardware, and a bad app self-recovers (reset re-enters OpenBootloader). REQUIRES the one-time SWD install of OpenBootloader at 0x08000000 (see the MeshCore tools/openbl-wle5 port); a stock Wio without OpenBootloader can only be flashed via SWD/J-Link. The Wio's ROM bootloader is NOT serial-reachable (USART1 on PA9/PA10, BOOT0 not bonded out of the module).
